{{Top|leg}}
'''Mesarc''' was a form of currency used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] during the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In addition, a mesarc was considered a measure of [[Time/Legends|time]].
